'''Sorian crystals''' were [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] recognizable by their radiance. The blade produced when used to power a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] would surge if it come into contact with another object moving at high speed. This could potentially throw off an opponent in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], allowing the wielder of the sorian-powered blade time for a counterstrike.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
